text:
Data/device split landed. Public surface: PlotCompiler.train(plot, options) -> TrainedPlotData (opaque; data-side phases: mapping, stats, scale training, row resolution, coord transforms, geom lowering, guide specs, semantics) and PlotCompiler.place(trained, context) -> TrainedPlot (device-side: layout solve, panel/axis/guide/label lowering). resolve(plot, context, options) is now literally the composition (single shared implementation, no parallel pipelines to drift). FacetCompiler split the same way; PanelResolution lifted to private[intaglio]; global + per-panel registries and free-scale retraining all on the train side; LayoutPolicy.metrics text measurement all on the place side.

Key deviation from the issue text: TrainedPlot (PlotCompiler.scala:160) was NOT the right cut — it is the fully-lowered end product (layout, guides, grobs). A new intermediate (TrainedPlotData) sits post-coord/pre-layout. Also, measurement showed geometry lowering takes no device inputs here, so grobs live on the train side; the split therefore skips row resolution AND geom lowering on resize, not just stats.

Acceptance evidence (receipt regenerated, performance/timings/v1.tsv, M3 Max, 12 runs):
- resize-place (train once, place at 5 sizes): 7.7 ms / 1.1 MB total vs resize-only (5 full recompiles) 1201 ms / 3441 MB — ~156x time, ~3000x allocation. ~1.5 ms per resize.
- Phase clock records zero mapping/stat/scale-training/resolve during placement (asserted in TrainPlaceSuite).
- TrainPlaceSuite (core shared, runs JVM+JS): place == resolve scenes across 6 plot shapes (scatter lean/rich, histogram, labelled line, facet wrap, sparse free-scale grid) x 3 contexts; purity; solver-requirement preserved.
- All suites green: core JVM 469, core JS 463, perf JVM 9, perf JS 2; tastyMiMa + interactionCompatibilityCheck + scalafmt pass.
- docs/limits.md updated: streaming bullet now distinguishes "no streaming" from "incremental compile exists"; measured-time section carries after-numbers.
